example_prompts: Write a 90-second upbeat birthday song for my friend Maya, who loves hiking and bad puns, and make the track.
Write lyrics for a sad country song about leaving my hometown.
Write a 30-second jingle for my coffee shop, Little Owl Coffee, and make the track.
Turn this poem into a folk song and make it: The porch light hums, the kettle sings, / my father whistles through the cold, / and every small and ordinary thing / is gold, is gold, is gold.
